newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Eight killed, 3 under rubble in Russian barracks.
newsitem.headline: Eight killed, 3 under rubble in Russian barracks.

text.p: Three people were trapped under rubble on Thursday after a military school dormitory in western Siberia collapsed, killing eight and injuring dozens, an Emergencies Ministry spokeswoman said.
"It is a very complicated building, unlike modern ones made of panels," she quoted Emergencies Minister Sergei Shoigu as saying by telephone from from the site of the collapse in the city of Tomsk.
"We have to clear the rubble effectively with bare hands."
About 150 people, most of them cadets, were in the three-storey building of the Tomsk Military Communications School when roofs caved in five minutes before the wake-up call.
The spokeswoman said earlier 42 people had been taken to hospital, and 10 of them were in a very serious condition.
Itar-Tass news agency quoted an official working for Tomsk's mayor as saying almost the entire dormitory, which had not been repaired since the early 1950s, collapsed.
The spokeswoman said the building had once been a monastery and was converted to a dormitory in the early 1950s. Then a third storey was constructed on top of the two existing ones.
